client: St. Martins College of Nursing Sciences Ubima Kelga Ltd/GTE
headline: A nursing college needed a corporate foundation able to satisfy two regulators at once.
challenge: A health-training institution answers to both education and health-sector regulators — its corporate structure and compliance documentation have to satisfy both from the outset.
delivered: Company Limited by Guarantee formation and governance documentation
Regulatory compliance mapping across education and health-training requirements
Administrative systems for institutional and student records
Advisory support on ongoing statutory and accreditation obligations
impact: A nursing college formally incorporated and structured to pursue accreditation and operate as a recognised health-training institution.
